summary: First build E2E test of XOLNET Technologies. Backend: 18/20 pytest pass (auth, admin protection, enquiry create->list, search/filter, status, notes, followup, metrics). Frontend: homepage + hero cards, multi-step enquiry modal (YT-XXXX ref), contact form, product quote/course enrol prefill, products search/category, training mode, work filters, admin login/redirect/protection, metrics, lead table, row status change, drawer note, status filter, CSV export, logout all working. Failures: rate limiter keyed on ingress pod IP (global, not per-client), admin search 500 on regex special chars, drawer notes lost on reopen (stale state).

critical.issue: Rate limiter uses request.client.host which is the k8s ingress pod IP (logs show 10.81.4.212 / 10.81.4.213), not the real visitor. Result: limit is shared by ALL visitors per ingress pod (~16 enquiries/5min site-wide) and genuine users will get 429; per-IP limiting does not work (10 sequential requests all 200 in one run, later run mixed 200/429 depending on pod). Fix: key on first IP of X-Forwarded-For (fallback X-Real-IP, then client.host).

minor.issue: Returns 500 - search is passed raw into Mongo $regex. Use re.escape(search).
No brute-force lockout (7 consecutive wrong passwords all 401, no 429). Playbook requires lockout after 5 failures.

send_email is awaited inline (30s httpx timeout) so a slow email provider delays the user response; use asyncio.create_task / BackgroundTasks for truly non-blocking. Email provider also returned 429 rate_limited during tests (enquiry still saved - OK).
ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD fall back to hardcoded defaults admin@example.com/admin123; should fail fast if missing.
Accepts empty note string; no length validation on note/message fields.

ui_bugs.issue: After adding a note, closing and re-opening the drawer for the same lead shows 'No notes yet' - addNote only updates `selected`, not the `leads` array (setSelected(l) reopens with stale lead). Fix: also update leads state in addNote (setLeads(ls => ls.map(...))).

issues: Search input triggers a full API reload (2 requests) on every keystroke - add debounce.

action_items: Fix rate limiter key to use X-Forwarded-For client IP instead of request.client.host
re.escape the admin search term before $regex
AdminDashboard addNote: sync note into leads state so reopened drawer shows notes
Add login brute-force lockout (5 fails) per auth playbook
Make lead email notification non-blocking (background task)
Remove hardcoded admin default credentials fallback
critical_code_review_comments: server.py rate limiter is in-memory and per-process; resets on restart and breaks with multiple workers
CORS allow_origins=* with allow_credentials=False is acceptable since auth is Bearer header (no cookies) - playbook cookie checks N/A by design
bcrypt hash verified $2b$; seed_admin updates password if changed - OK
ITProducts page product cards/quote buttons had no data-testid (added by tester)
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed enquiries during testing; all deleted afterwards (18 removed). Backend restarted once to reset in-memory rate-limit bucket.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest backend/tests/test_xolnet_api.py (test_zz_rate_limit exhausts bucket - restart backend afterwards before UI tests). Rate-limit test may pass by chance after fix depending on ingress pods; verify by sending X-Forwarded-For header variations. Recheck drawer note persistence on reopen.
rca of the issue: Rate limit: behind ingress, request.client.host = ingress pod IP; multiple pods => bucket per pod shared by all users. Search 500: unescaped user input to $regex raises Mongo regex compile error. Drawer notes: React state only updated on `selected` copy, leads list holds stale object.
